what_it_states: Pure-DP K-norm mechanism (Lemma 7, density proportional to exp(-eps||y-T(X)||)) and its Hardt-Talwar sampler (Lemma 8); optimal norm = induced norm of the convex hull of the sensitivity space per Awan-Slavkovic orders (Lemma 11); polytopes for Sum (B_1^{d,k} cap B_inf^d, Lemma 17), Count (Lemma 23) and Vote (permutohedra, Lemma 35) with exact uniform samplers in O(d^2) or O(d^2 log d) (Theorems 53, 65, 74, Lemma 73) and rejection-sampling inefficiency (Lemmas 22, 54, 59, Theorem 41); CDP elliptic Gaussian noise (Lemma 12) with minimum enclosing ellipses minimizing expected squared l2 norm of a uniform sample from the ellipse (Def 27, Lemmas 28-32, 42-44, Theorems 33, 45); remark that the Sum ball is identical across orthants so spherical Gaussian noise is optimal (CDP); parallel sampler (Lemma 76). For d=2, k=1 the Sum ball is exactly the closed unit l1 diamond, but the only statements about it are K-norm sampling/optimality in the Awan-Slavkovic orders and spherical-Gaussian CDP optimality among elliptic Gaussians.
what_it_does_not_state: No statement over ALL additive noise laws under pure DP; its squared-l2 criterion is only for the enclosing-ellipse (elliptic Gaussian, CDP) family; no pure-DP squared-Euclidean optimum, selector, value or equality for the l1 diamond; no staircase optimizer; no mixed-cost all-law bound E||Z||_2^2 >= (2/3) inf E||Z||_1^2; no rounded-core selector.
